### TagGroup

<ApiTable kind="props" :items='[
  {
    "name": "modelValue",
    "type": "AcceptableValue | AcceptableValue[]",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The controlled value of the selected tag(s). Can be binded with <code>v-model</code>. An array when <code>selectionMode</code> is <code>multiple</code>.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "defaultValue",

    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The value of the selected tag(s) when initially rendered. Use when you do not need to control the selection.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "selectionMode",
    "type": "TagGroupSelectionMode",

    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The type of selection that is allowed. Tags are not selectable when <code>none</code>.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "disallowEmptySelection",
    "type": "boolean",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>When <code>true</code>, the user cannot deselect the last selected tag.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "escapeKeyBehavior",
    "type": "\"none\" | \"clearSelection\"",
    "default": "&#39;clearSelection&#39;",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Whether pressing &amp;lt;kbd&amp;gt;Escape&amp;lt;/kbd&amp;gt; clears the selection.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "disabled",
    "type": "boolean",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>When <code>true</code>, prevents the user from interacting with the tag group and all its tags.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "dir",
    "type": "Direction",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The reading direction of the tag group when applicable. &amp;lt;br&amp;gt; If omitted, inherits globally from <code>ConfigProvider</code> or assumes LTR (left-to-right) reading mode.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "loop",
    "type": "boolean",
    "default": "true",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>When <code>true</code>, keyboard navigation will loop from last tag to first, and vice versa.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "by",
    "type": "string | ((a: AcceptableValue, b: AcceptableValue) => boolean)",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Use this to compare objects by a particular field, or pass your own comparison function for complete control over how objects are compared.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "asChild",
    "type": "boolean",
